title: Megurine Luka — A Happy Doll Festival♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Yay!
Tag! You're it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! Rin, I'm over here♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ready or not, here I come♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's so full of energy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And how about you, Luka? Are you enjoying yourself?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This Doll Festival party is also your welcoming party, so we want you to have as much fun as possible♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course I'm having fun.
I never knew it could be so spectacular♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, this feels more like a regular party than anything Doll Festival related...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, let's not get bogged down in the details. Everybody's having fun and that's what matters.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I hope Tsukasa and Saki are having a blast too...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm? Having a blast...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just a figure of speech that translates to having a lot of fun. It's supposed to represent how you're bursting with joy and such.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ What Rui said☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That being said, it's still sort of a wonder as to how you actually understand what she's saying...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm sure Tsukasa's having just as much fun as everyone here is.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially considering that he's with his family.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd like to hear about how his party went the next time he comes here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... *Yawn*...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Are you getting sleep, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes...
Mind if I borrow your lap?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm just... So sleepy...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Fine, alright. Come here, you.
Just for a little bit, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank...
Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Already...?!
Out just as she laid down...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Luka fell asleep?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we wanted her to play tag with us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. That'll have to wait.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: *Mumble*...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Look, she's smiling♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She must be having a nice dream.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But why is it that she can sleep this much...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Does it have to do with her connection to this SEKAI? Possibly how Tsukasa's feelings were part of why this SEKAI came to be...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That may very well have something to do with it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is somewhat unrelated, but I think I've figured out when Luka tends to fall asleep...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You have?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think so. She seems to feel sleepiest when everyone around her is smiling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When they're having fun or enjoying themselves, she starts falling asleep.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The opposite seems to be true as well since she's almost never sleepy when something is bothering someone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She'll attentively listen to what someone has to say.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Luka looked fully awake when Tsukasa was talking to her about something pretty serious...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So whenever Luka feels like being a sleepyhead, it's a good thing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which mean, if she does tend to fall asleep when everybody here is having fun as MEIKO says...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then this SEKAI must be overflowing with smiles and joy considering she can sleep this soundly.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz... Hehe...
